name: South Carolina
description: Follow South Carolina, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Democrats approve new primary election calendar, putting South Carolina first
changes.summary: Democrats chose South Carolina for the first 2028 presidential primary, then Nevada, prioritizing Black and Latino voters. New Hampshire, New Mexico, Michigan and Virginia also hold early contests. (Image credit: Sean Rayford/Getty Images).

changes.title: There are already more U.S. measles cases this year than in all of 2025
changes.summary: This year has easily become the U.S.'s worst year for measles since 1991, as major outbreaks in South Carolina, Utah and Arizona have sickened hundreds and smaller clusters of cases sparked in other states.

changes.title: South Carolina and Nevada Fight to Kick Off Democrats’ 2028 Presidential Calendar
changes.summary: The calendar order could be hugely important to the 2028 presidential primary race. Democratic insiders will try to sketch out a schedule this week, and rival states are sniping at one another.

changes.summary: Former Rep. Trey Gowdy insists he’s not interested in running in the South Carolina special election. But a new poll suggests Gowdy would be formidable if he changed his mind. changes.title: There’s a power struggle brewing in South Carolina, and Trump might not win
changes.summary: The race to fill Lindsey Graham’s seat has created a new test of President Donald Trump’s power. South Carolina Republicans aren’t sure Trump will pass. Sen. Darline Graham, who was appointed last week to fill the remainder of her late brother's term, announced Monday she will seek a full term for her brother’s old sea.

changes.title: Lindsey Graham’s Sister, Darline Graham, Says She Will Run to Succeed Him
changes.summary: Ms. Graham, who filled her brother’s Senate seat in South Carolina after his death, does not appear to have previous political experience. But she does have President Trump’s endorsement.

changes.title: South Carolina's governor appoints Lindsey Graham's sister to serve out his term
changes.summary: Gov. Henry McMaster says he is appointing Darline Graham to finish the term of her late brother, former Republican Sen. Lindsey Graham, who died in office Saturday at age 71.
